lines: Some nights you can feel before you see them. The tram is full an hour early, scarves hang out of the windows, and somewhere up ahead the first song has already started. We have never stood on this ground before. But we know this walk. Ticket in hand. The gate. The steps. And then the noise — all of it, at once.
